description: Nutrition facts for a food from its barcode (UPC/EAN, via Open Food Facts) or its name (USDA FoodData Central): calories, protein, fat, saturated fat, carbs, sugars, fiber and sodium per 100 g or 100 ml, per serving and for gram amounts when the source uses grams, with % Daily Value from the FDA's reference values. Volume-based foods aren't converted to grams without density. Barcodes also give ingredients, allergens and Nutri-Score. When a brand is known, FDA recall reports matching it are included. Meals: send items (foods by name or barcode with grams or servings, or restaurant menu items with the numbers you read on the chain's own nutrition page) and optional daily targets; divux adds them up exactly, with % Daily Value and what's left of each target. Use for questions about what's in a food, comparing foods, whether a meal or menu order fits someone's goals, or whether a packaged food was recalled. Not medical or diet advice. Not for medicines (use check_medicine) or skincare and cosmetics (use check_cosmetic).

amount_g.description: Amount eaten in grams, to scale the values

barcode.description: UPC or EAN printed under the bars, 8 to 14 digits

fdc_id.description: A USDA FoodData Central id from an earlier result's alternatives

items.description: For a meal: each food or menu item; divux adds them up

name.description: Item name, e.g. 'Chipotle chicken burrito bowl'

nutrients.description: Per-serving numbers you read on a restaurant's or brand's own nutrition page, instead of a lookup

query.description: Food name to look up, with brand when known
Food name, with brand when known, e.g. 'Chobani plain Greek yogurt' or 'banana'

targets.description: The person's own daily or meal targets, for what's left
